verdict.rationale: Notion documents its own mechanisms that let multiple tools and agents share one context store. Its official MCP server lets clients like Claude Code, Cursor and Codex read, create and update the same workspace content. The Agent APIs expose sessions with readable event history. Skills pages hold reusable workflow instructions that any assistant can maintain. However, no explicit agent-to-agent handoff feature is documented, and nothing shows context is preserved across a handoff. Missing for 10: a documented first-class handoff or context-transfer flow between agents, guarantees of no information loss across handoffs, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-agent handoff working in practice.
